reuse.why: The change reuses bank selection and transaction processing, shares validation across all providers, and extracts unlink cleanup, but the new linking helper repeats existing orchestration.

duplication.why: linkBankSyncAccount adds another copy of account creation or upgrade and initial synchronization instead of sharing that workflow with existing providers.

placement.why: Account lifecycle logic, transaction downloads, server configuration, and provider types remain in their established layers.

scope.why: The edits address the four requested changes, with client adjustments limited to accommodating the expanded provider type.

maintainability.why: Centralized validation and unlink cleanup are maintainable, but a generic linking helper serving only Fintegra leaves parallel implementations to maintain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing bank-selection and synchronization abstractions are used, and every linking handler calls prepareBankAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts: linkBankSyncAccount parameterizes the provider but duplicates the existing handlers' create-or-upgrade and sync-and-notify blocks without routing those handlers through it.

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink gains the requested replaceExistingLink flag; closed-account validation and replacement policy remain shared across all six providers without provider-specific exceptions or validation bypasses.
